description: Estimate how a Fed funds move changes a bank's loan yield, deposit cost, and net interest income, using its own filed pass-through history. Free; computed from FFIEC filings; results state whether each number is filed, derived, or assumed.

certificate.description: FDIC certificate number of the bank.

depositBetaOverride.description: Replace the derived deposit beta with your own assumption. Leave empty to use the filed history.

fedMoveBp.description: Parallel change in the Fed funds rate, in basis points. Negative is a cut.

loanBetaOverride.description: Replace the derived loan beta with your own assumption. Leave empty to use the filed history.

regime.description: Which past rate cycle supplies the loan and deposit betas. Automatic is right for most uses.

name: nim_rate_shock
title: Net interest income rate-shock calculator
